message.content:
This editorial illustration features a red background with large white letters spelling "TEMPO" at the top. Below the title, the text "50 Tahun!" is written in white cursive. A large, transparent glass vial with a gray metal cap and a white label dominates the right side of the image. The label reads "TARIK-ULUR FATWA VAKSIN" in large, black, blocky letters. Underneath, smaller text in black and red says: "Majelis Ulama Indonesia menyatakan vaksin AstraZeneca haram karena mengandung babi. Benarkah ada permintaan imbalan sebelum fatwa keluar?". 

To the left of the vial, a person in a white robe and headgear holds up a large, dark stamp. The bottom of the stamp features a stylized red pig's face. The person is looking upwards with an open mouth. At the top left, the text reads "ORANG ASING DI VAKSIN NUSANTARA / BOSOWA VERSUS OTORITAS JASA KEUANGAN". The bottom left corner contains a date "22-28 MARET 2021", a price "RP 45.000", a QR code, and a barcode. The overall style is a flat digital illustration with soft shading.
